Smt. Sushma Devi vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2024
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 40205 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt. Sushma Devi

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Himadari Batra,Sr. Advocate,Vivek Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the State.

2.  The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the following prayer:
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed this Hon'ble Court be pleased to allow this application and to secure the ends of justice this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to stay effect and operation of the judgment and order dated 11.10.2023 passed by the Sessions Judge Chitrakoot in Criminal Revision No-64 of 2023 (Smt. Sushma Kesarwani v/s State of UP) and the judgment & order dated 10.8.2023 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, whereby the application of the applicant for release of material seized by the Police in Pursuance to the registration of Criminal Case No-122/2023 registered under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, section 59 of Food Safety Standard Act 2006, section 63, 65, 68 of the Copyright Act, 1957, section 103 & 104 of the Trade Mark Act, 1999 registered at Police Station-Rajapur, Chitrakoot is rejected.

order dated 10.8.2023 passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Chitrakoot

sentences.text:
whereby the application of the applicant for release of material seized by the Police in Pursuance to the registration of Criminal Case No-122/2023 registered under sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 272, 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, section 59 of Food Safety Standard Act 2006, section 63, 65, 68 of the Copyright Act, 1957, section 103 & 104 of the Trade Mark Act, 1999 registered at Police Station-Rajapur,
Chitrakoot is rejected.

It is further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct release of the material seized by the police on superdari in favor of the Applicant, else the applicant will suffer irreparable loss and injury.
And/or pass other and further order which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the facts and circumstances of the case."
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the premises of applicant was raided by police authority and certain items were seized.
The details of which have been stated in para 26 of the application.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that although the challenge to the seizure is made on the basis that police have no authority under law to seize the goods, however, at this stage,
since the report of Food Analyst has come up in the short counter affidavit, applicant is confining its prayer for release of products, which have found to be safe by the Food Analyst in it's report, which is annexed along with short counter affidavit filed by the State.
3-A.

Learned counsel for the applicant has drawn attention of this Court to page 9 of the short counter affidavit dated 1.3.2024 filed by the State to submit that peppermint for pan masala has not been found to be adulterated and supari, cardamon & clove mixture were found to be substandard only on account of excess moisture.

Learned counsel for the applicant has further drawn attention of this Court to page 12 of the short counter affidavit to submit that supari has found to be substandard on the basis of excess moisture.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the aforesaid three items may be released, as the moisture may be on account of excess rain and the products can be sold after complying with the substandard fixed by the Authority under law.
3-b. Learned counsel for the applicant also submits that the machinery which has been seized may also be released.
The details of which have been stated in page 15 of the application.

She further submits that packaging material may also be released after keeping the sample with the Authorities,
which shall be duly countersigned by the applicant.

4. Learned AGA submits that he would have no objection in respect of products which have been found to be safe and in respect of products which have been found to be substandard, may be released subject to the condition that products, food items which have been found to be substandard, shall not be sold in the market except after complying with the standard prescribed Smt. Sushma Devi vs State Of U.P. on 19 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128056202/
2 and subject to the satisfaction of the Food Safety Authority.
5.

entities.text: Sushma Devi vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is to be seen that in the present case, the application for release of items has been rejected by the court concerned on the ground that investigation is going on.
Perusal of short counter affidavit would demonstrate that report of Food Analyst in respect of items seized have already been received.
The First Information Report was lodged on 29.6.2023.
Sufficient time has already lapsed for opposite party to have completed the investigation.
Seized items, which are of substandard quality and which can be made standard quality and the machinery including packaging materials cannot be kept and are required to be released.

6. In view of the aforesaid, the following items i.e. Generator-2 of 15 KV, packing machine-5, oven machine-1, electronic weighing scale-7, perfumed supari-62 bags of 15 kg each, 24 bags of 15 kg each, 5 packet (34 x 48 per pouch), 2 brand name jani supari packet and 8 kg bundle jani brand packing material, 5 bundle of 8 kg each, as well as Pepermint of Pan masala, Supari, Cardamom &
Clove mixture and Supari, as per page 9, 11, 12 of short counter affidavit dated 1.3.2024 shall be released by the court concerned subject to undertaking being given by the applicant that the machinery shall not be sold during pendency of the case and shall be produced before the court whenever it is required.

So far as food items are concerned, which are substandard on account of excess moisture, the same shall not be sold in the public without the same being converted into standard quality and to the satisfaction of the Food Safety Authority and the details of the same shall be sent to opposite party in writing within 30 days.
The sample of the product materials, which are being released shall be kept on record after the signature of applicant made on the sample.

7. To the aforesaid extent, the impugned order dated 11.10.2023 passed by the Sessions Judge,
Chitrakoot is modified and in respect of other products, the impugned order is upheld.
8. With the aforesaid observation/direction, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
